'''Nangchang Jar soup '''is a [[Jiangxi]] cuisine of China, and it is meat soup which is carried by jar and stored in a big crock. Similar to [[Guangdong]] soup, the Jiangxi jar soup can be made from various ingredients from pork-bone, chicken and duck  to different kinds of Chinese medicinal materials like [[ginseng]], codonopsis and [[Chinese wolfberry]].<ref name="CHN">[http://kreader.cnki.net/Kreader/CatalogViewPage.aspxdbCode=CJFQ&filename=JKYY2015Z1039&tablename=CJFD2015&compose=&first=1&uid=WEEvREcwSlJHSldRa1FhdkJkdjAzeW9TZ1JaWGVjaFBuNnNraHlWQ1NYMD0=$9A4hF_YAuvQ5obgVAqNKPCYcEjKensW4ggI8Fm4gTkoUKaID8j8gFw!! Cuisine，Health & Nutrition.  China Academic Journal Electronic Publishing House. Year vol#]</ref>

Nonetheless, the Jiangxi jar soup has its own uniqueness which makes it differ from other kinds of Chinese soup.<ref name="CHN" /><ref>[http://kreader.cnki.net/Kreader/CatalogViewPage.aspx?dbCode=CJFQ&filename=BXSX201206032&tablename=CJFD2012&compose=&first=1&uid=WEEvREcwSlJHSldRa1FhdXNXZjJDUGg3QWZQUlNHMytzN1M2YlRCOENrYz0=$9A4hF_YAuvQ5obgVAqNKPCYcEjKensW4ggI8Fm4gTkoUKaID8j8gFw!!
